method: 2024: use population exactly as printed in JF regional tables wherever a row exists, including its explicit missing value for Kosovo. Reference years vary or are unspecified; year is survey-wave join key, reference_year is population date only when known. For areas not listed in those tables and all earlier survey waves, retain the previous Wikipedia-first/World Bank annual population snapshot. Never backfill the JF 2024 denominators into earlier waves.
